title: TermTables
description: The scoring model exported as lookup tables. The phone adds up matching term points for a product and profile, applies hard stops, and computes score = base_score - points (NOMI-051, NOMI-060).

model_version.description: Version of the exported model, e.g. 'rubric-v0.1'.

rubric_version.description: Version of docs/rubric this export implements, e.g. 'v0'.

base_score.description: Score before any points are taken off. Normally 100.

terms.description: Points per ingredient, dimension and persona, plus extra points for conditions and medication types.

hard_stops.description: Rules that make a product red regardless of points.

tier_bands.title: TierBands
tier_bands.description: Score thresholds for each tier. Below yellow_min is red.

green_min.description: Lowest score shown as green, e.g. 75.

yellow_min.description: Lowest score shown as yellow, e.g. 50.

combine.title: Combine
combine.description: How points from several ingredients in one product combine within a dimension.

method.description: 'max' takes the largest ingredient's points; 'max_plus_stacking' adds stacking_points for each extra ingredient that scores on the same dimension; 'sum' adds all.

stacking_points.description: Extra points per additional ingredient on the same dimension, for max_plus_stacking.

term.title: Term
term.description: Points taken off for one ingredient on one dimension for one persona. A row with a condition or medication_type applies only when the profile has it, on top of the base row.

points.description: Points taken off. Rows with 0 points are not exported.

hard_stop.title: HardStop
hard_stop.description: A rule that forces the result tier. Matches when the product contains the ingredient and the profile matches every given field.

personas.description: Personas the rule applies to. Omit to apply to all.

result.description: Tier forced when the rule matches.

message_template_id.description: Explanation template shown when the rule fires.
